side_overlap_inspection.interpretation: Missing inspection is not zero reuse. Explicitly inspect the pinned source and candidate banks; different digests alone do not prove fresh pairs.

pin.estimand: Fresh recertification token_delta of start-by/complete-by phase-qualified deadline clauses against careful English that names the same qualifying event and a non-qualifying state; 12 authored pairs, balanced 6/6 across distinct domains and disjoint from all 36 retrievable prior pair records.
admissibility_gates: all 12 pairs are present and unique
exactly six start-by and six complete-by cells
each English arm explicitly distinguishes genuine start or successful completion from a named non-qualifying state
no English or Ainglish sentence duplicates any of the 36 retrievable prior pair records for this construct
both registered encodings load and match the preregistered deterministic fingerprints
every per-pair delta and both marker-stratum means are reported even if adverse

disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)
settlement_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

proposal.title: start-by / complete-by — say which task event a deadline constrains

environment.encoding_fingerprint_method: sha256 over ainglish-tiktoken-encoding-fingerprint-v1 NUL, encoding name NUL, every mergeable token ordered by (rank, bytes) as 4-byte big-endian token length + token bytes + signed 8-byte big-endian rank, then every special token ordered lexically in the same representation

manifest.item_selection_rule: Six start-by and six complete-by cells were authored and frozen before tokenization. They span laboratory work, physical logistics, software operations, excavation, transcription, analysis, customs, medical delivery, irrigation, ballot processing, firmware, and certification. Exact English and Ainglish surfaces were checked against all 36 retrievable prior pair records for this construct and are disjoint.
manifest.method: For each registered encoding and each frozen pair, count the complete UTF-8 sentence with tiktoken 0.14.0 ordinary encode and no special tokens. Per-pair delta is tokens(ainglish) minus tokens(english). Report each encoding mean, both marker-stratum means, the balanced grand mean across all 24 encoding-item cells, and every per-pair delta. The filed scalar is the least-favourable encoding mean; value_lo/value_hi are the minimum/maximum encoding means. Encoding identities remain version-free for register comparability; library version and deterministic vocabulary fingerprints are separate provenance. No comprehension, adoption, or phase-fidelity inference is permitted.

manifest.comparison_note: This deterministic recertification measures token cost against complete phase-qualified English only. It does not measure or imply comprehension, adoption, or whether readers distinguish start from successful completion.
